capabilities: detect completed tasks with a configurable regex containing a completion-date capture group
delete tasks older than a user-set number of days
remove indented description lines under deleted tasks
restrict scanning to files matching a filename filter
show a confirmation modal with per-file deletion counts before deleting
problem: Obsidian keeps completed tasks in notes forever, so users who date their task completions end up with cluttered files they must clean by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin is fully compatible with the Tasks plugin.

summary: Maintenance plugin that deletes completed tasks older than a set number of days from Markdown notes, after showing a confirmation summary.
